question: If in a code language, 'BEAM' is written as 'YVZN', then how will 'HELP' be written in the same code language?
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a10c5cbae900f7e1b740808c1234ab57dc8a53a7c6a1c281b88ec733fe6ec063.png] 

'BEAM' is written as 'YVZN',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/25302aa9d487aebad42d968125069788ee1c3b2081457dd8ce6c5842b2c77ca2.png] 

Similarly,

**'HELP' will be written as :**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f99bf9f6aef845baa521db75e7bc1d86ae7e67f976e577d81ef15679424a9aa1.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"SVOK".**
